title: British steam locomotive
request:
Build an old British steam train. The person asked for "an old British train". When asked whether they wanted a steam locomotive with its coal tender (like the Flying Scotsman) or a full train with carriages, they answered "yes", so the default is a classic steam locomotive with its coal tender, in the style of the LNER A3 Flying Scotsman. No carriages for now.

Defaults:
- Purpose: realistic studio render, at real-world scale. The locomotive and tender together are about 21 m long, about 2.7 m wide and about 4 m tall from the rail head. Include a short straight section of track (rails, sleepers, ballast) under it.
- Wheel layout 4-6-2 Pacific: a 2-axle front bogie, 3 large driving wheels per side (about 2.03 m diameter) joined by coupling and connecting rods, one trailing axle under the cab, and outside cylinders at the front. The tender rides on 6 wheels (3 axles per side).
- Body: a long cylindrical boiler with a black smokebox and smokebox door at the front, a short chimney, a steam dome, safety valves, running boards along both sides with valances, an enclosed cab with side windows and a roof, and a tender with coal heaped on top.
- Colours (picker values): boiler, cab and tender in LNER apple green #4F7A3A with thin black-and-white lining. Smokebox, chimney, frames, running boards and wheel tyres in satin black #1A1A1A. Driving wheel centres in green or black. Front and rear buffer beams in signal red #B22222. Brass or copper details (dome cap, whistle, number plate, safety valves) in #B5893A, metallic. Coal in matte black. Painted parts semi-gloss, with slight wear.
- Details: round buffers and a coupling hook on the buffer beam, a front number plate on the smokebox door, lamp irons, handrails along the boiler, and a cab number on the side.
- Keep everything hard-surface and clean. Rods and wheels must line up correctly with the axles. Use a three-quarter hero render with neutral studio lighting.

spec.object: Old British steam locomotive with coal tender (LNER A3 Flying Scotsman style, 4-6-2 Pacific)
spec.summary: A classic LNER apple-green 4-6-2 Pacific steam locomotive with its six-wheel coal tender, standing on a short straight piece of track. The black smokebox, long lined green boiler, enclosed cab and coal-heaped tender are rendered at real-world scale in a three-quarter studio hero shot. No carriages.
